name: Access Control
description: Reusable access-control guidance for identity, ownership, role boundaries, tenant boundaries, privilege escalation, and audit.
activation_conditions: Requirement exposes user-specific, tenant-specific, private, or role-gated records.
known_limitations: Generic guidance; project policy and authoritative requirements take precedence.
conflict_policy: Surface DOMAIN_PROJECT_CONFLICT; do not override authoritative project requirements.
